```yaml
name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  source:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y cmake

      - name: Build source packages
        run: |
          mkdir build && cd build
          cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
          cpack --config CPackSourceConfig.cmake

      - name: Upload source artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: source-packages
          path: build/*.tar.bz2
          path: build/*.zip

  windows-installer:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Use shared composite action
        id: windows_installer
        uses: ./.github/actions/windows-installer/action.yml
        with:
          build_type: Release
          test_flags: ''

      - name: Upload installer artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: installer
          path: ${{ steps.windows_installer.outputs.installer_path }}

  release:
    needs: [source, windows-installer]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Download artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: source-packages
          path: source-packages

      - name: Download installer artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: installer
          path: installer

      - name: Create release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref }}
          release_name: Release ${{ github.ref }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false

      - name: Upload source packages as release assets
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: source-packages/*.tar.bz2
          asset_name: Gammu-${{ github.ref }}.tar.bz2
          asset_content_type: application/x-bzip2

      - name: Upload installer as release asset
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: installer/Gammu-${{ github.ref }}.exe
          asset_name: Gammu-${{ github.ref }}.exe
          asset_content_type: application/octet-stream
```
